Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

The submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner in the context of his claim for the bail is on the ground that he has been framed in a false and frivolous case at the instance of the prosecutrix on the narrative that she as a resident of Rajasthan, had come to Katra in April, 2021 by undertaking bus journey and then in Katra came to be in company of the petitioner against whom she on reaching back to the Rajasthan on 17.04.2021 registered as Zero FIR dated 08.01.2022 to allege that she had fallen victim to the crime at the hand of the petitioner which included offence under section 376(2) of the Indian Penal Code in addition to other offences.

On the basis of registration of this Zero FIR with the Police Station, Jodhpur in Rajasthan, the same was transferred to the Police Station, Chirwa, Rajasthan where it came to be registered as FIR no.
21/2022 dated 10.01.2022 where it remained pending before getting transferred to Katra Police Station to be registered as FIR no. 249/2022 dated 15.09.2022 which resulted in arrest of the petitioner on 13.11.2022 and consequent presentation of challan on the basis of alleged investigation carried out by the Police Station, Chirwa and not by the Police Station, Katra.

The petitioner's plea for bail came to be rejected by the learned Principal Sessions Judge, Reasi in terms of an order dated 22.12.2022 and that is how the petitioner is now seeking the indulgence of this Court in the matter for grant of bail.

sentences.text: Police Station, Katra is on record to say in its police report that the investigation whatsoever carried out by the Police Station, Chirwa has been borrowed by the Police Station, Katra to lay the police report meaning thereby the Police Station, Katra at its own has not carried out any investigation in the eyes of law and still the petitioner has come to be subjected to criminal case under trial.

The very legality of the challan is being questioned by learned counsel for the petitioner to submit that the atleast the petitioner, in such, like case is entitled to bail instead of suffering incarceration.
Before considering the matter to its logical end, this Court deems it appropriate to send for the scanned record of the case from the Court of Principal Sessions Judge, Reasi.
Let requisite record be sent from the Court in reference.
List this case for consideration on 07.02.2023.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 19.01.2023 Shivalee Munish Sharma vs Ut Of J&K And Another on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140318738/
